I've answered Tobias in the thread on his message in #inc-tansley-carrier-api. The depot was Southgate.

- **What the channel shows:** On 2025-09-03, Pree wrote in that channel that label printing had stalled at the Tansley Parcel depots and Southgate dispatch had totes stacked beside door 4. At 18:43 she posted that it was fixed and Southgate had cleared the backlog. Tobias is a member of the channel, so he can see all of this himself.
- **What's missing:** Nothing he can see says which city Southgate is in, and I told him that.
- **A possible mix-up:** The Central team weekly for 9/8, a Central team page, says the same outage made yard clerks at the Little Rock and Shreveport hubs enter trailer arrivals by hand (ticket INC-44912). That was the gate check-in problem, not the label printing one. I pointed this out so he doesn't confuse the two on the call.

I left out the contract and discount details that also came up in the search. He didn't ask for them, and the account belongs to Pree, not Tobias.
